Bettina, I haven't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler refused my request with a credentials error, so nothing is scheduled and nothing has been posted.

Here is what I'd set up once the scheduler is reachable:

- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** a single post in #coastal-team.
- **What:** the previous week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items those channels mention.
- **Limits:** I'd use only what those two channels contain, not DMs or search results. I'd leave out money terms and finance documents, since those go only to Anselm, June and the account owner. Seat counts, renewal and signing dates, ticket numbers and contacts are fine to include.

#coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reach anyone who can't already read both channels.

Someone with admin access to the Gateway will need to fix the scheduler credentials. Once that's done, tell me to retry and I'll create the job and run one test digest so you can check the format before the first Monday.
